name: SOICT 2026
full_name: The 15th International Symposium on Information and Communication Technology
summarization: SOICT 2026 is an international symposium covering significant research areas such as AI Foundations and Big Data, Networking and Communication Technologies, Multimedia Processing, AI Applications, Generative AI, Applied Operations Research and Optimization, and Recent Advances in Cyber Security. The symposium provides an academic forum for researchers and graduate students to share their latest research findings and identify future computer science challenges. It features tutorials, keynote speeches by world-class speakers, and proceedings published in the Springer CCIS series.

name: RIVF 2026
full_name: RIVF 2026 – The 20th International Conference on Computing and Communication Technologies
summarization: The Research, Innovation and Vision for the Future (RIVF) conference serves as a major scientific event for researchers, professionals, and students in computing and communication technologies. The 2026 edition features paper submissions across various tracks, tutorials on emerging topics like LLMs and vision-language models, and keynote speeches by prominent researchers. It aims to foster international and national academic collaboration in Vietnam.

name: AICON 2026
full_name: 6th EAI International Conference on Artificial Intelligence for Communications and Networks
summarization: The 6th EAI International Conference on Artificial Intelligence for Communications and Networks (EAI AICON 2026) focuses on artificial intelligence methods and systems that directly advance communication technologies, network infrastructures, and connected autonomous systems. It brings together researchers, engineers, and practitioners working at the intersection of AI, communications, and networking to discuss AI-enabled design, optimization, operation, and protection of wireless, mobile, satellite, optical, IoT, and cloud-edge networks.
location: Phu Quoc Island, An Giang province

name: ICEEIS 2026
full_name: 1st International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Intelligent Systems 2026
summarization: The ICEEIS 2026 conference provides an international forum for researchers and professionals to share recent advances and foster collaboration in electrical, electronics, and intelligent systems. Topics cover areas such as AI, intelligent control, robotics, renewable energy, embedded systems, IoT, and wireless communications. The event is organized by HCMC University of Technology and Engineering (HCM-UTE), Vietnam.

name: AMI 2026
full_name: The 1st International Conference on Autonomous Machine Intelligence
summarization: The International Conference on Autonomous Machine Intelligence (AMI 2026) is an international forum dedicated to the study of autonomous, self-supervised, and predictive learning systems. The conference brings together researchers and practitioners to advance the foundations and applications of next-generation intelligent systems capable of learning and acting with minimal human supervision, focusing on paradigms such as world models, energy-based models, and joint embedding predictive architectures.

name: ICEBA 2026
full_name: 12th International Conference on E-Business and Applications
summarization: The 12th International Conference on E-Business and Applications (ICEBA 2026) aims to address essential complexities in e-business by inviting papers focusing on systems, software, services, and enterprise-oriented digital transformation. It encourages researchers, practitioners, and enterprise leaders to contribute insights and cutting-edge research under the theme of cross-border integration and intelligent upgrade. The event features keynote speeches, paper presentations, interactive workshops, and panel discussions.

name: REV-ECIT 2026
full_name: Hội nghị Quốc gia lần thứ XXIX về Điện tử, Truyền thông và Công nghệ Thông tin
summarization: REV-ECIT 2026 is the 29th National Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology organized by the Radio-Electronics Association of Vietnam (REV). The conference covers topics across electronics, communications, and information technology, with a particular focus on national strategic technologies.

name: AICI 2027
full_name: The Eighth International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computational Intelligence
summarization: The International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computational Intelligence brings together researchers to present and discuss theoretical and applied research problems in artificial intelligence, computational intelligence, and related soft computing techniques with biomedical and related applications, as well as to foster research collaborations.
location: Thang Long University, Nghiem Xuan Yem Road, Dinh Cong District, Hanoi

name: ICIIT 2027
full_name: 2027 12th International Conference on Intelligent Information Technology
summarization: The International Conference on Intelligent Information Technology (ICIIT 2027) provides an interactive forum for presentation and discussion on intelligent information technology and related fields. It brings together researchers and professionals from around the world to establish global ties and explore career opportunities. The event features technical sessions, keynote presentations, and peer-reviewed paper publications.

name: ICCIES 2027
full_name: International Conference on Computational Intelligence in Engineering Science
summarization: ICCIES 2027 is an annual international academic forum that provides a platform for researchers, academics, and professionals to exchange knowledge, share experiences, and explore innovations and emerging trends in intelligent computing across a broad range of engineering disciplines. The conference brings together participants from universities, research institutions, and industry to foster international collaboration, disseminate research findings, and discuss recent advances in engineering sciences.
location: Ton Duc Thang University, Ho Chi Minh City

name: AAMAS 2027
full_name: The 26th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems
summarization: AAMAS 2027 is the 26th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems, serving as the largest and most influential conference in the area of agents and multiagent systems. It brings together researchers and practitioners to present and discuss the latest developments in agent and agentic technology.

name: MobiSys 2027
full_name: The 25th ACM International Conference on Mobile Systems, Applications, and Services
summarization: ACM MobiSys 2027 aims to showcase innovative and impactful research on the design, implementation, usage, and evaluation of mobile computing and wireless systems, applications, and services. It is the 25th edition of the conference, sponsored by ACM SIGMOBILE.

name: EASE 2027
full_name: International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering
summarization: EASE is an internationally leading venue for academics and practitioners to present and discuss their research on evidence-based software engineering and its implications for software practice. The 31st edition of EASE will take place in Hanoi, Vietnam, welcoming high-quality submissions across various tracks including full research papers, short papers, industry papers, and workshops.

name: WCST 2026
full_name: 4th World Conference on Smart Tourism
summarization: The 4th World Conference on Smart Tourism focuses on synergizing industry and academia, specifically harnessing AI for transformative tourism and hospitality in the Global South. It brings together researchers and professionals to discuss smart tourism, technology integration, and hospitality innovations.

name: TSE 2026
full_name: 2026 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Search & Rescue and Emergency Response Systems
summarization: The 2026 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Search & Rescue and Emergency Response Systems (TSE 2026) provides a forum for exchanging ideas, discussing research results, and presenting cutting-edge innovations at the intersection of science, technology, and emergency management. The conference brings together researchers, engineers, practitioners, policymakers, and industry leaders to address challenges in search and rescue operations and emergency response.

name: SIMC 2026
full_name: The First International Conference on Semantic Intelligence in Massive Computing (SIMC) 2026
summarization: SIMC 2026 is a specialized forum focusing on semantic intelligence in massive computing environments, including cloud computing, edge-fog architectures, IoT, and large-scale data-driven platforms. It brings together researchers and industry experts to discuss advances in semantic modeling, knowledge representation, reasoning mechanisms, and artificial intelligence for intelligent decision-making. The conference aims to foster interdisciplinary collaboration and contribute to the advancement of explainable and knowledge-driven intelligent systems across domains like smart cities, finance, and healthcare.

name: CSoNet 2026
full_name: The 15th International Conference on Computational Science and Network Intelligence
summarization: The 15th International Conference on Computational Science and Network Intelligence (CSoNet 2026) serves as an interdisciplinary forum for researchers, engineers, and practitioners to present research on the theoretical foundations, methodological advances, and real-world applications of computational intelligence, network science, and data-driven methods. The event covers diverse topics including network intelligence, computational science, artificial intelligence, and applications in complex systems. Accepted papers are published in Springer's Lecture Notes in Computer Science or selected prestigious journals.
location: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HCMUT), Ho Chi Minh City

name: ICTA 2026
full_name: International Conference on Advances in Information and Communication Technology
summarization: The International Conference on Advances in Information and Communication Technology (ICTA 2026) aims to provide an international forum for researchers, academics, industry experts, and practitioners to exchange innovative ideas, research findings, and practical experiences in the field of Information and Communication Technology (ICT). The conference focuses on the rapid convergence of Artificial Intelligence (AI), advanced ICT infrastructure, and cybersecurity technologies transforming modern societies, smart cities, and digital industries. It seeks to bridge the gap between theoretical research and real-world applications, fostering interdisciplinary collaboration.

name: ICDSAIA 2026
full_name: International Conference on Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Applications
summarization: The International Conference on Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Applications (ICDSAIA 2026) brings together experts, researchers, and innovators from around the world to explore the latest advancements in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and their real-world applications. Attendees engage with thought leaders, collaborate with peers, and discover groundbreaking solutions shaping the future of these fields.
location: East Asia University of Technology, Phan Tay Nhac Street, Xuan Phuong Ward, Hanoi

name: AIEI 2027
full_name: International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Energy and Infrastructure
summarization: AIEI 2027 is the second edition of the international conference dedicated to artificial intelligence for energy systems, resilient infrastructure, and sustainable cities. Hosted by COSARI at Van Lang University, it brings together researchers, engineers, and professionals to share recent results on smart energy, infrastructure, AI and data, and reliability. The audience includes academics, industry professionals, and students discussing responsible and impactful AI solutions.

name: IEEE SMC 2027
full_name: 2027 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics
summarization: The 2027 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (IEEE SMC 2027) focuses on systems science and engineering, cybernetics, and human-machine systems under the theme "Human-AI Symbiosis: Engineering Intelligent, Autonomous, and Sustainable Futures". It provides an open international forum for researchers and industry innovators to discuss challenges and design intelligent systems that prioritize human well-being and societal sustainability.
location: Sheraton Saigon Grand Opera Hotel, Ho Chi Minh City

name: FJCAI 2027
full_name: Hội thảo khoa học về Trí tuệ nhân tạo
summarization: Hội thảo khoa học về Trí tuệ nhân tạo là diễn đàn học thuật toàn quốc thường niên, quy tụ các nhà nghiên cứu, giảng viên, nghiên cứu sinh, sinh viên và chuyên gia trong lĩnh vực Trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) nhằm trao đổi, chia sẻ các kết quả nghiên cứu mới nhất, xu hướng phát triển, thách thức và ứng dụng của AI trong các lĩnh vực khác nhau.
location: Trường Đại học Công nghệ Thông tin và Truyền thông Việt - Hàn (VKU), Quận Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng

name: IEEE NICE–TEAS ASIA 2026
full_name: 4th IEEE Networking International Conference on Emerging Trends in Expert Systems, Applications & Security, ASIA
summarization: The 4th IEEE Networking International Conference on Emerging Trends in Expert Systems, Applications & Security, ASIA (NICE-TEAS ASIA 2026) brings together researchers and professionals from over 20 countries. The conference focuses on emerging trends in expert systems, applications, and security, with proceedings to be submitted for inclusion in IEEE Xplore.

name: ENASE 2027
full_name: Evaluation of Novel Approaches to Software Engineering
summarization: The mission of ENASE is to be a prime international forum to discuss and publish research findings and IT industry experiences with relation to novel approaches to software engineering. The conference addresses evolution in systems and software thinking due to contemporary shifts of computing paradigms to AI-assisted coding, low-code/no-code platforms, cloud and edge computing, security and DevSecOps, IoT integration, and sustainable engineering. It aims to identify hopeful trends and propose new directions for researchers and practitioners involved in software design, programming, integration, deployment, delivery, maintenance and evolution.

name: GCHRCLI 2027
full_name: Global Conference on Human Rights, Cybersecurity & Legal Innovation
summarization: The Global Conference on Human Rights, Cybersecurity & Legal Innovation (GCHRCLI) provides an international platform for academicians, researchers, engineers, and industrial participants to share research findings and experiences with global experts in human rights, cybersecurity, and legal innovation. The conference aims to foster international research collaborations, business relations, and knowledge exchange.

name: ICCSS 2027
full_name: 2027 10th International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Simulation (ICCSS)
summarization: The 2027 10th International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Simulation (ICCSS) provides a platform for scientists, engineers, technicians, and graduate students to share research experiences and ideas in circuits, systems, and simulation. The conference invites contributions focusing on topics such as circuit simulation and modeling, automotive circuits and systems, computer aided network design, and electronic design automation. Accepted papers will be published in the conference proceedings.

name: 8th IEEE AICAS 2026
full_name: 2026 IEEE 8th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Circuits and Systems
summarization: The 8th IEEE AICAS 2026 is a flagship event for the IEEE Circuits and Systems Society focusing on cutting-edge research in artificial intelligence circuits and systems. It brings together researchers and professionals to discuss topics such as in-memory computing, hardware/software co-design, neuromorphic circuits, and emerging AI applications. The conference fosters innovation and emerging businesses in Ha Long Bay, Vietnam.

name: REV 2026
full_name: Hội nghị Quốc gia lần thứ XXIX về Điện tử, Truyền thông và Công nghệ Thông tin, REV-ECIT 2026
summarization: The 29th National Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (REV-ECIT 2026) is an annual national scientific conference organized by the Radio and Electronics Association of Vietnam (REV). The conference covers topics across electronics, communications, and information technology, with a special focus on national strategic technologies.

name: ICE 2027
full_name: ICE IEEE/ITMC
summarization: The ICE 2027 conference invites high quality papers contributing to substantial, original, and previously unpublished research in the topics of engineering, technology, innovation, and entrepreneurship, bringing together researchers, innovation experts, and practitioners.

name: ICERA 2026
full_name: 9th International Conference on Engineering Research and Applications
summarization: The 9th International Conference on Engineering Research and Applications (ICERA 2026) serves as an international forum for researchers, practitioners, and academics to share recent developments in engineering research, applications, and economics. The conference covers tracks in mechanical engineering, materials and mechanics, mechatronics and micro mechatronics, automotive engineering, electrical and electronics engineering, information and communication technology, and economics.
